remarks: Welcome home to this wonderful 2 bedroom, 1 bath unit located in the heart of Harbor Point. The unit has been freshly painted and has many upgrades. Light-filled kitchen features ample cabinet space, stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Also features a large pantry or coat/storage closet. Step into the large combo dining/living area with brand new chandelier, new blinds and slider to a private deck. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Primary bedroom with generous closet space and shelving. Secondary bedroom also has ample closet space. Full bath has new vanity, lighting and fan. This unit comes with TWO assigned parking spaces. This location is convenient to the vibrant Harbor Point area, shops, restaurants, minutes to the train & 95, convenient to get anywhere in Stamford!
